summary: Allow guarded agents to plan and apply filtered repairs with their literal seat identity

replay.detail: No claim replay or repair planning changes.

compatibility.detail: repair apply carries optional actor attribution. Bound harnesses must supply their own actor; unbound callers cannot supply one, while legacy token-only unbound requests remain accepted. repair.applied retains its four-field envelope and daemon/runtime author for older peers; authenticated caller JSON is stored in reason before the existing legacy-closures suffix. Subject/class filters and approval tokens are unchanged. Dry-run and conversations status remain actorless GETs; optional CLI --as compatibility remains available until the guard read-classification rollout.

downtime.detail: Agent apply requires the updated CLI and daemon. No storage migration or replay is required.

manual.detail: Use st repair dry-run --as "$ST_AGENT" --class revoked-legacy-runtime-start --subject SUBJECT, then st repair apply --as "$ST_AGENT" TOKEN. Existing leading-actor guards support this compatibility spelling without Home Manager activation; after the read-policy rollout, dry-run and status need no --as.

recovery.detail: No persistent state or recovery changes.
